entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH  Appearance:
Shri Rajesh Joshi - learned Govt. Advocate for the res  ORDER

This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 28.07.2010 in Sessions Case No.67/2010 by the Third Additional Session Judge, Barwani whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Section 376(2)(f) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I. and fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation of months additional R.I.
2.

This appeal arises out of the incident dated 16.03.2010 in which appellant committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix (minor) against her will and regarding which a Crime No.23/2010 was registered at Police Station Niwali, District - Barwani (M.P.).
3.

The PUD No.335/Warrant/2025 dated 24.06.2025 of Jail Superintendent, Sub- Jail, Sendhwa,
District - Barwani mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 20.06.2017 after completing the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21079 2 CRA-1422-2011 sentence and depositing the fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
